what: One trace member (./traces/39/trace_full_a6a739.json, 21153882 bytes compressed, against 439350 bytes for the next largest member of that day) was excluded from ingest. Parsing it exhausted memory in a pool worker and stopped the day.
mechanism: src/tashwish/ingest/pipeline.py, MAX_MEMBER_BYTES = 8 MiB, added after the frozen state and before this day was processed.
effect: Detector logic, thresholds and the frozen state are unchanged. Rows of one aircraft on one day are missing. Effect on day level results is not measured.
